question: In which year did Wilhelm Johannsen coin the term ‘gene’ to describe the Mendelian units of heredity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1909**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Wilhelm Johannsen** coined the term **'gene'** in **1909**.
 
• This term was used to describe the** Mendelian units of heredity**, which are the fundamental units of genetic inheritance.
 
• Johannsen's work was crucial in the development of the field of gene
